design_vision.vibe: Tactical Minimalism. Authority, Mission-Critical Urgency, High Clarity.
design_vision.rationale: For a missing person investigation command center, the UI must reduce cognitive load while highlighting critical real-time alerts. Dark mode (tinted cool grey) reduces eye strain for long monitoring sessions. High-contrast accent colors immediately draw the eye to active AI matches and critical updates. Everything must be actionable within 5 seconds.

fonts.heading: font-sans (Configure Tailwind to use 'Chivo' or 'IBM Plex Sans' for headings. NEVER use Inter for headings.)
fonts.body: font-mono or font-sans (Use 'IBM Plex Sans' or 'Inter' with increased tracking for legibility in data tables.)

layout_and_spacing.structure: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or lg:grid-cols-12 for advanced spanning.
layout_and_spacing.gap: gap-4 or gap-6 for high data density.
layout_and_spacing.containers: Cardless or flat cards. Use rounded-md (max 8px). Avoid soft shadows. Use 1px solid strokes (border border-slate-800) to separate widgets.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: F-Pattern Hierarchy. Most critical metric or active alert feed must be Top-Left. AI Map Top-Right or spanning full width in its own row.
layout_and_spacing.padding: Internal padding for widgets should be p-4 or p-6.

component_strategies.navigation: Sticky top nav or persistent left sidebar. Glassmorphism is BANNED. Use solid bg-slate-950 with a border-b border-slate-800.
component_strategies.real_time_alert_feed: Dense list. Left border color indicates priority. Include Timestamp, Priority Badge, ID, and Action. Use staggered entrance animations for new alerts.
component_strategies.ai_predictive_insights: Use the 'Terminal/Retro-Futurism' micro-theme. bg-slate-950 with border-cyan-500/30. Add a subtle drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(34,211,238,0.3)] to the border to signal AI activity.
component_strategies.metric_cards: Single-metric focus. Large font for the number, small uppercase overline for the label. Add a tiny sparkline chart (Recharts) in the background or right side.
component_strategies.map_container: Use a dark map style (e.g., Mapbox Dark). If using static map placeholders, overlay with bg-slate-950/40 to ensure UI elements on top remain readable.
component_strategies.charts: Shadcn Chart components (Recharts). Use the defined alert colors (blue, emerald, cyan) for data lines. Hide grid lines or make them extremely subtle (stroke-slate-800).
component_strategies.interactive_elements: ALWAYS explicitly set hover text colors. e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white.

libraries_and_tools.ui_components: Shadcn UI (Cards, Tables, Badges, Tabs, Dialogs, Select, Dropdown Menu)
libraries_and_tools.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight for tactical density)
libraries_and_tools.notifications: Sonner (for real-time toast popups on critical alerts)

logos_and_badges.description: Law Enforcement Agency Badge / Logo Placeholder

map_texture_fallback.description: City map topology placeholder for background maps if no active map library is used

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid: CRITICAL: All interactive elements, alerts, metric cards, and charts MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="alert-feed-item-critical"`, `data-testid="ai-match-button"`).
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against colored badges maintains a 4.5:1 ratio. For Critical red badges, use text-red-100 or text-white on pure red, or text-red-400 on dark red backgrounds.
testing_and_accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. New alerts sliding in must be quick and snappy (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).
